description: This file defines an abstract class 'BrandedBottomSheetDialog' that extends Android's BottomSheetDialog and implements branding functionality by applying a brand color on start.

classes.name: BrandedBottomSheetDialog
classes.description: An abstract dialog class that applies branding color when the dialog starts.
